regime_read: The desk is flagging a crowded AI/gov-contract convergence but several of the loudest names (PLTR, CRWD) are already extended and carry a Trump-linked SELL print, so the edge in those is noted, not actionable here. The cleaner alignment sits in non-extended semis (AMAT, MU) with multi-channel corroboration, while the rest is single-channel noise.
regime_read_zh: 台面呈现拥挤的 AI/政府合同共振，但最响亮的标的（PLTR、CRWD）已处延伸状态且带有特朗普关联卖出记录，其优势已被确认但无法操作。更干净的共振在非延伸的半导体（AMAT、MU），有多通道佐证，其余多为单通道噪音。

theses.thesis: The strongest convergence in the pack: congress_cluster shows 4 members net-add with a ~$51M disclosed position [congress_cluster], an analyst upgrade cluster with 0.97 bull ratio [analyst_upgrade_cluster], a deep patent cluster (293 filings) [patent_cluster], rising news sentiment (0.86 bull) [news_sentiment], and elevated unusual options activity (0.611 OI ratio, put/call ~1.07, call-skewed on elevated vol) [unusual_options]. The name is down ~31pp vs SPY over 60d, so the entry is not extended. Combined with the House 'Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act' catalyst [bill:HR10170], the read points to a Washington-driven semicap cycle that AMAT catches first as the tool supplier.
theses.thesis_zh: 全包中收敛最强：国会集群 4 名议员净增持约 5100 万美元披露头寸 [congress_cluster]，分析师上调集群看多比例 0.97 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]，专利集群 293 件 [patent_cluster]，新闻情绪 0.86 看多 [news_sentiment]，异常期权活动 OI 比 0.611、看涨倾斜（put/call 1.07）[unusual_options]。60 日相对 SPY 落后约 31 个百分点，入场点未延伸；叠加众议院《内存芯片竞争力评估法案》参考催化剂 [bill:HR10170]，指向华盛顿驱动的半导体资本开支周期，AMAT 作为设备供应商率先受益。
second_order: MU — same semicap cycle plus direct Memory Chip Act exposure, earnings in 7 days
NVDA — foundry/design demand flows through tooling demand
KLAC — peer semicap with same gov/patent/cycle tailwind
LRCX — same WFE upcycle, not in pack but implied by AMAT strength
evidence: bill_catalyst: HR10170 Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act
theses.dissent: The biggest risk is that congressional buying in AMAT is merely portfolio re-allocation to a laggard, not a signal; the 1.07 put/call is only mildly call-skewed, and semicap leadership can turn on a single AI spend headline.

falsifier.text: A high-profile AI capex guidance cut or a semiconductor-zone tariff escalation that takes AMAT-specific WFE orders below consensus within the holding window.

The House Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act [bill:HR10170] is a direct named-market catalyst. Relative strength is only ~-11pp vs SPY, so the pre-earnings run is still early.

second_order: AMAT — tooling demand precedes MU bit output
WDC — NAND peer with same pricing dynamics
evidence: bill_catalyst: HR10170 Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act
theses.dissent: The 18.6% earnings-surprise history means the move may be priced in by the time the print lands; a 7-day horizon is short and earnings can crack any setup.

falsifier.text: A memory pricing print or MU guidance call that trails consensus for the next two quarters inside the 30-day window.

second_order: AMAT — tooling supplier with cleaner congressional cluster at cheaper RS
MU — memory silicon, same AI demand spine at better entry
TSM — the other sanctioned fabric in this cluster
AVGO — AI silicon peer benefiting from the same capex wave
theses.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that NVDA is the most obvious AI name in the market; congressional buying here says nothing new, and the perfect 1.0 bull ratio from analysts at this size is a contrarian yellow flag.

falsifier.text: A NVDA guidance call that lowers the next-12-month AI-cohort earnings floor below current consensus, which would sink the entire semicap convergence read.

The signal is real but generic — BRK is a classic congressional parking lot for hedged beta. falsifier.text: A continued risk-on tape where cyclicals outperform defensives, leaving BRK's flat RS behind the index.
